# Your Local AI

**One-click local AI installer + landing page** (OpenCode → Ollama → dynamic model → scrape demo)

**Status:** Linux and Windows supported. Mac support coming soon.

## What it does

Your Local AI is a multi-platform installer that sets up a complete local AI environment:

1. **Installs OpenCode** (CLI + runners)
2. **Installs/checks Ollama** (version check, auto-install if needed)
3. **Downloads a RAM-sized local model** from dynamic config (v0: Gemma variants)
4. **Runs a fixed scrape demo** to prove token speed
5. **No hardcoded models** — config is fetched at install time, not frozen in the installer

## Install

### Linux

#### Quick start

```bash
npx @yourlocalai/your-local-ai install --os linux
npx @yourlocalai/your-local-ai run --demo scrape
```

#### Using the installer script

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rapidstartup/your-local-ai/main/installers/install-linux.sh | bash
```

#### Dry run (see the plan without installing)

```bash
npx @yourlocalai/your-local-ai install --os linux --dry-run
```

### Windows (Interim Node/CLI)

Requires Node.js 18+. Windows installer uses official Ollama download path.

#### Quick start

```powershell
npx @yourlocalai/your-local-ai install --os windows
npx @yourlocalai/your-local-ai run --demo scrape
```

#### Using the PowerShell wrapper

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\installers\install-windows.ps1
```

#### Dry run

```powershell
npx @yourlocalai/your-local-ai install --os windows --dry-run
```

**Note:** Windows support accepts `--os windows` or `--os win32`.

### Mac

Mac support is coming soon.

## Dynamic config

Config is never hardcoded. Fetch order:

1. `YLA_CONFIG_URL` environment variable
2. `https://sites.vibedash.app/your-local-ai` (parse `#yla-config` JSON)
3. Package-local `config/default.json` fallback

This allows updating model pointers, Ollama versions, and other settings without releasing a new installer.

## Commands

### `install --os <linux|windows|win32> [--dry-run]`

Install OpenCode, Ollama, and a RAM-sized local model.

- `--os linux` — Target Linux
- `--os windows` — Target Windows (also accepts `win32`)
- `--dry-run` — Show installation plan without executing

### `run --demo scrape`

Run a fixed scrape demo to test token speed.

- `--demo scrape` — Demo type (only 'scrape' available)

## Structure

```
.
├── bin/cli.js                  # CLI entry point
├── lib/
│   ├── cli.js                  # Command dispatcher
│   ├── config.js               # Dynamic config loader
│   ├── install-linux.js        # Linux installer logic
│   ├── install-windows.js      # Windows installer logic
│   ├── run-demo.js             # Demo runner
│   ├── system-info.js          # System detection utilities
│   └── index.js                # Main exports
├── config/default.json         # Fallback config
├── installers/
│   ├── install-linux.sh        # Linux installer script
│   ├── install-windows.ps1     # Windows PowerShell wrapper
│   └── install-mac.sh          # Mac stub (coming soon)
├── site/index.html             # Landing page with WebMCP
└── test/                       # Tests (config fetch + dry-run)
```

## Tests

```bash
npm test
```

Tests cover:
- Config fetch order (env → remote → fallback)
- Dry-run installation plan
- System detection (OpenCode, Ollama, RAM)
- Model selection based on RAM

Tests are mocked and require no GPU.

## Landing page

The landing page at `site/index.html` includes:

- Live version panel (from config JSON)
- CLI documentation
- WebMCP manifest for agent-driven install
- OS detection with Linux CTA live, Mac/Windows disabled

## What this does NOT include

- Mac installer (coming soon)
- Billing or domains beyond VibeDash Sites path
- Open-ended scrape UX (fixed demo only)
- Signed/notarized installers
- Forever-hardcoded models (everything is dynamic)

## Development

```bash
# Install dependencies (none currently)
npm install

# Run tests
npm test

# Test CLI locally
node bin/cli.js install --os linux --dry-run
node bin/cli.js install --os windows --dry-run
node bin/cli.js run --demo scrape
```

## Hosting

- Landing: `https://sites.vibedash.app/your-local-ai` (VibeDash Sites)
- Repo: `https://github.com/rapidstartup/your-local-ai` (private)
- npm: `@yourlocalai/your-local-ai` (v0, not yet published)

# Dogfood Instructions for v0.1.4

This document provides instructions for testing Your Local AI v0.1.4 installer inputs and CLI features **without pulling multi-GB models**.

## Quick Test: Install with Goal (No Model Download)

### Linux
```bash
node bin/cli.js install --os linux --skip-model --goal "Extract company facts from a short page"
```

### Windows
```bash
node bin/cli.js install --os windows --skip-model --goal "Extract company facts from a short page"
```

## Goal Management

### Show Current Goal
```bash
node bin/cli.js goal show
```

### Set Goal from Command Line
```bash
node bin/cli.js goal set --text "Summarize technical documents"
```

### Set Goal from File
```bash
echo "Extract key metrics from financial reports" > my-goal.txt
node bin/cli.js goal set --file ./my-goal.txt
```

## Dry-Run Tests (No Installation)

### Linux Dry-Run with Goal
```bash
node bin/cli.js install --os linux --goal "Test goal" --dry-run --skip-model
```

### Windows Dry-Run with Goal
```bash
node bin/cli.js install --os windows --goal "Test goal" --dry-run --skip-model
```

### Dry-Run with Goal File
```bash
echo "Extract company information" > test-goal.txt
node bin/cli.js install --os linux --goal-file ./test-goal.txt --dry-run --skip-model
```

## Non-Interactive Install Tests

### Full Hands-Off Install (No Model)
```bash
node bin/cli.js install --os linux --skip-model --goal "Extract facts from web pages"
```

### Verify Non-Interactive Requires Goal
This should fail with a clear error message:
```bash
# Create a non-TTY environment by piping stdin
echo "" | node bin/cli.js install --os linux --skip-model
```

Expected error:
```
Error: User goal is required in non-interactive mode
To proceed, run with: --goal "Your goal here"
```

## Run Demo (Only if Model Already Present)

If you already have `gemma2:2b` or another compatible model locally:

```bash
node bin/cli.js run --demo scrape
```

The demo will incorporate your saved user goal into the prompt if one is set.

```bash
node bin/cli.js --help
```

### Install Help
```bash
node bin/cli.js install --help
```

### Goal Help

```bash
node bin/cli.js goal --help
```

## File Locations

After install, check these locations:

### Linux/Mac
- Runner directory: `~/.your-local-ai/`
- Config: `~/.your-local-ai/config.json`
- User goal: `~/.your-local-ai/user-goal.txt`
- Runner script: `~/.your-local-ai/runner.sh`

### Windows
- Runner directory: `%USERPROFILE%\.your-local-ai\`
- Config: `%USERPROFILE%\.your-local-ai\config.json`
- User goal: `%USERPROFILE%\.your-local-ai\user-goal.txt`
- Runner script: `%USERPROFILE%\.your-local-ai\runner.bat`

# Parity Checklist: UI ≡ CLI ≡ WebMCP

- **UI**: Interactive terminal prompts and user interactions
- **CLI**: Command-line flags for non-interactive/hands-off operation
- **WebMCP**: Agent-readable instructions in site/index.html skill-md

Version: 0.1.4

| Model download confirmation | TTY prompt | `--yes-pull-model` or `--skip-model` | ✓ Flags documented |
| User goal input | TTY prompt during install | `--goal "text"` or `--goal-file path` | ✓ Flags documented (v0.1.4) |
| Dry-run mode | `--dry-run` flag | `--dry-run` flag | ✓ Flag documented |
| Installation plan display | Shown with `--dry-run` | Shown with `--dry-run` | ✓ Behavior documented |

## CLI Flags Summary (v0.1.4)

| Flag | Purpose | Required? | Example |
|------|---------|-----------|---------|
| `--os <linux\|windows>` | Target operating system | ✓ Yes (install) | `--os linux` |
| `--goal "text"` | Set user goal inline | ✓ Yes (non-TTY) | `--goal "Extract facts"` |
| `--goal-file path` | Read goal from file | ✓ Yes (non-TTY, alt) | `--goal-file ./goal.txt` |
| `--skip-model` | Skip model download | No | `--skip-model` |
| `--yes-pull-model` | Auto-confirm model download | No | `--yes-pull-model` |
| `--dry-run` | Show plan without executing | No | `--dry-run` |

## Error Handling Parity

| Scenario | UI Behavior | CLI Behavior | Documented? |
|----------|-------------|--------------|-------------|
| Missing `--os` | Error + usage message | Error + usage message | ✓ Yes |
| Missing goal (non-TTY) | Error + suggest `--goal` | Error + suggest `--goal` | ✓ Yes |
| Model download (non-TTY, no flag) | Error + suggest `--yes-pull-model` | Error + suggest `--yes-pull-model` | ✓ Yes |
| Goal file not found | Error with file path | Error with file path | ✓ Yes |
